channel.description: Latest stories from Sankaku Complex through AniNews Hub.

item.title: AION 2 Players Fascinated by Surprisingly Detailed Breast Customization
item.description: AION 2 has finally launched as a free-to-play MMORPG, and while its massive open world and combat are getting plenty of attention, players in Japan and overseas have quickly become fascinated by something else: its remarkably detailed breast customization options.

item.title: Macross 7 & WHITE ALBUM 2 Animator Kenichiro Katsura Dies at 59
item.description: Veteran Japanese animator and character designer Kenichiro Katsura, known for his work on Macross 7 and numerous AQUAPLUS titles including WHITE ALBUM 2, has died at the age of 59.

item.title: CyberConnect2 CEO Says Games Going Fully Digital Would Have “Nothing but Positive Effects”
item.description: CyberConnect2 CEO Hiroshi Matsuyama has come down firmly on the side of an all-digital future for video games, arguing that the disappearance of physical games would have “nothing but positive effects” for developers.

item.title: 16% of Japanese Digital Manga Readers Have Completely Abandoned Physical Manga
item.description: Digital manga may be enormously popular in Japan, but surprisingly few of its readers have completely abandoned physical books.

item.title: Sony Brings PS5 Pro-Style AI Upscaling to the Regular PS5
item.description: Regular PlayStation 5 owners can now get a taste of one of the PS5 Pro’s biggest graphical features, as Sony has introduced a new AI-powered upscaling technology designed specifically for the standard PS5.

item.title: Foreign Tourism Falls in Osaka as Chinese Visitors Plunge 59%
item.description: Osaka’s foreign tourism numbers have fallen despite record numbers of visitors arriving from several countries, as a massive 59% decline in Chinese tourists outweighed growth almost everywhere else.

item.title: D&D Artist Criticizes “Politically Correct” Industry After His Classic Cover Is Censored
item.description: A classic piece of Dungeons & Dragons artwork has been quietly altered nearly four decades after its creation, and original artist Clyde Caldwell isn’t particularly pleased with the change.

item.title: Tokyo Metro Tests AI That Directs Passengers Toward Less Crowded Train Cars
item.description: Tokyo Metro is experimenting with AI and floor projections to steer commuters away from crowded train cars, potentially making packed rush-hour journeys a little more manageable.

item.title: Capcom Forms Dedicated Team to Improve Character Graphics Across All Its Games
item.description: Capcom has established a dedicated cross-functional team tasked with spreading the latest RE ENGINE character technology across all of its games, allowing advancements developed for one title to more easily benefit future projects.

item.title: Harry Potter’s Malfoid Meme Spawns Wave of Tasteful Art
item.description: The internet’s latest obsession with Draco Malfoy has transformed the Harry Potter character into “Malfoid,” a female reinterpretation that has inspired artists around the world into creating artwork of the sassy female wizard.

item.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance Co-Founder Hopes GTA VI Makes $80 Games the New Standard
item.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios hopes Grand Theft Auto VI will do more than sell millions of copies – it wants Rockstar’s blockbuster to make more expensive video games easier for the rest of the industry to sell.

item.title: Life-Size Uma Musume Figures of Orfevre & Gold Ship Arrive at ParisLongchamp
item.description: Umamusume: Pretty Derby has officially arrived at one of the biggest events in real-world horse racing, with life-size figures of Orfevre and Gold Ship now on display at ParisLongchamp Racecourse ahead of the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe.

item.title: Artist Deletes Female Draco Malfoy Fan Art & Apologizes After “Malfoid” Backlash
item.description: The popular “Malfoid” trend – turning Harry Potter’s Draco Malfoy into an anime girl – has now produced its own controversy, with illustrator Yunayu deleting her contribution and repeatedly apologizing after receiving criticism over the fan art.

item.title: FF7 Remake Director Says Team “Hasn’t Altered the Core of the Story” Despite Major Changes
item.description: Final Fantasy VII Remake director Naoki Hamaguchi says the remake trilogy “hasn’t altered the core of the story” based on fan reactions – a striking statement considering just how dramatically the new games have already departed from the original Final Fantasy VII.

item.title: New To Love-Ru Book Appears to Be Selling Out as Fans Rush to Buy It
item.description: Nearly a decade after To Love-Ru Darkness ended, the franchise’s newest manga release appears to be attracting strong demand in Japan, with copies disappearing from at least some stores shortly after going on sale.
